entities.summary: Jontay Porter is an American professional basketball player for the Seattle Super Hawks of the USBL. Porter was banned for life by the National Basketball Association (NBA) in 2024 for violating their gambling policies while playing for the Toronto Raptors. The scandal resulted in him facing criminal charges, for which he pled guilty.
